A sandbox is a separate test company with a copy of your setup: departments, teams, SLA, assignment rules, macros, templates, notification rules, the Knowledge Base, modules and fields, and workflow rules. It holds none of your tickets or customers, and it never sends email or calls your integrations. Administrators and the agents you choose sign in to it by picking it at login. Once a day, tickets that have been archived for the number of days you choose are written into an encrypted archive file and removed from the live Desk, so lists, search and reports stay fast. Their attachments are kept with the archive. Tickets on legal hold are never moved. You can find any archived ticket here and bring it back. Archive rule Which tickets leave the live Desk.
